titel: Daybreak Weekend: US CPI, ECB Decision, BRICS Summit

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts; Ausschnitte dieser Sendung waren in zwei Messungen mit Stunden Abstand stumm - die Datei wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt

einzeiler: US inflation data, upcoming ECB interest rate decision, and the BRICS summit in focus
kurzfassung: This episode covers the crucial US consumer and producer price inflation reports ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting. It also examines the European Central Bank's expected rate decision amid a global bond market sell-off and energy price pressures. Additionally, the program previews the 18th BRICS summit in India, focusing on geopolitical dynamics and energy security.
stichpunkte: US inflation data releases for August include the producer price index and the consumer price index.
Federal Reserve officials weigh strong employment figures against persistent inflation pressures before the September policy decision.
Corporate earnings reports feature Oracle, Adobe, and Macy's amid broader market focus on AI infrastructure demand and retail health.
The European Central Bank is widely expected to raise interest rates again to combat stubborn inflation.
Global bond markets experience a significant sell-off driven by higher energy prices, geopolitical tensions, and resilient economic growth.
India hosts the expanded 18th BRICS summit, bringing together eleven member nations to discuss energy access, supply chains, and international cooperation.

kapitel.titel: European Central Bank and Bond Markets

clips.hook: Upstream pressures and AI infrastructure build-out
clips.text: Producers face front-line energy costs and expenses linked to the artificial intelligence infrastructure boom, raising concerns that these expenses will reach consumers.
Adobe shares experience a significant rebound despite earlier market apprehension regarding artificial intelligence disruption in the software sector.

clips.hook: Energy-driven inflation and core rate slowdown
clips.text: While overall figures appear elevated due to energy costs, specific core gauges monitored by policymakers show encouraging signs of slowing down.
Market veterans view current bond yields as a normalization following years of artificially suppressed rates caused by quantitative easing and central bank interventions.

clips.hook: The long game in US-China relations
clips.text: Despite sharp rhetoric and trade disputes, Beijing maintains a strategic focus on ensuring a smooth and successful upcoming summit with the United States.

beschreibung:
Bloomberg Daybreak Weekend with Host Nathan Hager take a look at some of the stories we'll be tracking in the coming week.
In the US – a look ahead to the U.S CPI and PPI reports and a focus on 3 stocks for the week ahead.
In the UK – a look ahead to the next decision from the European Central Bank.
In Asia – a look ahead to the 18th BRICS Summit in India.
